ChatOut.description:
What every chat turn returns, so a script can score a task without reading prose. `needs` lists what is still required:
`student_signature` / `parent_signature` (a device-key signature on the exact draft) or `info:<slot>` (a question to answer).
ChatOut.title: ChatOut

post.description:
Approve (or decline) a held payment AS THE ROLE OF THE SESSION. Approving needs a signature, made with that
role's registered device key, over the pending payment's exact draft hash. The role string grants nothing.

get.description: What the login screen needs. Public. Never returns a passcode.
Who am I? 200 {"role": null} when logged out (a probe, not an error); the role and device key otherwise.

post.description: Advance the simulated clock and let the agent do its Tier-1 work (rate targets, recurring bills).
Hand the real executor a tampered, replayed or forged signed intent in the caller's own sandbox (MOCK money).
Every executor attack in one request (counts once against the red-team limit).
Run `n` deterministic attacker variants (offline templates + mutations) against the defender; return a scoreboard.

Natural-language tasks (agent/chat.py). Every reply carries intent, status, pending_id, draft_hash, needs, money_moved and
proof_id so a script can score it. A payment ends as a held draft that only the student's device-key signature releases.

get.description:
Once per session: what is due soon, the shortfall and an offer to plan (reply is null when there is nothing to say or it was already said).
A 'yes' in the next /api/chat turn continues into the plan. Read-only apart from the chat dialog state.

Every corridor rule with its value, precise source, retrieval date, confidence and status (confirmed-primary |
researched-secondary | unconfirmed). Read-only view of the YAML data file; any logged-in role may read it.

post.description: Read-only rule findings (limits, tax) for one payment, each with its source and status. Not legal advice.
Read-only: what to send per route so the recipient gets `required` even in the worst case. Moves no money.

get.description: Read-only: evidence held vs missing per ask, with a ready payload for /trust-pass/issue. No approval is promised.
Read-only: milestones, what Oasis can and cannot verify, upcoming real obligations. Writes nothing.

post.description: Read-only what-if over Oasis's own metrics (hypothetical, not saved, not a score or a lender prediction).
Back to a clean (non-demo) sandbox; also wipes the SQLite state.
Play a whole scripted demo run in one call (same result every time, no network).

Reset to the scripted demo world (fixed seed, fixed MOCK data) and return the step list. `mode` "offline" (default)
uses the offline LLM; "live" replays recorded Amazon Nova Pro responses from the fixture (no network).
Register (or rotate to) the Ed25519 public key of THIS role's device. The private key never reaches the server.

get.description: PUBLIC (what the QR opens): re-verifies the shared passport now. The code only locates it.
Student only: executed payments to registry-verified payees that an Evidence Passport can be issued for.

post.description: Student only: keeps a passport that verifies against this server under a short code for a QR.
PUBLIC: verifies a pasted passport against THIS server's pinned keys. Needs no secrets, changes no state.

get.description: Reconcile and advise. Advisory only: a new payment must go through the normal request, policy and approval path.

post.description: Layer a MOCK rail event (credit / delay / reject / short_credit) on the journey. Never touches the ledger.
Student only: moves money between the student's OWN sandbox balances, so it never pays anyone. Audited.

SANDBOX (MOCK): add a USD or EUR tuition bill to one of two fixed MOCK universities, issued by the MOCK registry. The payee
and its account never come from the caller. Paying it still needs a plan, your signature and the executor.

get.description: Which real channels are on (never any secret): the email upload is always available; Telegram and IMAP need env config.

post.description:
A real email as a .eml file (in a mail client: Save as / Download message). Same pipeline as the paste box; the
sender's authentication results, a diverging Reply-To and hidden text become risk evidence, never authority.

Image intake via the agent model. If the image cannot be read the result is a low-confidence hold
asking the student to paste the text or confirm the fields; nothing is guessed.

The student's explicit "pay again" for a suspected duplicate (R17). It re-runs the held request with `pay_again`
set and a FRESH draft: the result is an ordinary held payment, with the duplicate warning attached, that must still
be signed with the student's device key. Nothing is paid here.

The agent builds a plan by calling read-only tools and revising from the validator's errors. It is a PROPOSAL:
nothing is paid or converted until the student accepts it, and executing it goes through the normal pipeline.

A plan for obligations owed in USD or EUR over the extra corridors. A PROPOSAL like any plan: accepting and executing it
runs through plan_exec (registry account, student signature, signed intent, executor). Refused (400) when nothing is owed
in a foreign currency.
The parent's SIGNED consent to one parent-remitted conversion step of an accepted plan.

Run the accepted plan's steps that are due today. Payments go through the full pipeline; anything that needs
approval is registered as a pending approval for the student (and parent) exactly like a normal intake. A
parent-remitted conversion runs only once the parent has signed their consent.
PUBLIC: verifies an uploaded pack against the pinned keys. Needs no secrets and changes no state.

get.description: PUBLIC and harmless: returns only check results for a pack that already exists.

post.description: The 'ask' step after a freeze: the student approves the recovery plan. Nothing is paid here.

Judge-only console. Runs in a SEPARATE sandbox world (its own ledger, registry and simulated approvers) that can
never touch the student's ledger. Rate-limited per client and size-limited; every attempt is logged.

Student only. Signs a payment-reliability record of the payments that completed the full pipeline with a verified
proof pack. It is not a credit score.
PUBLIC: verifies a record against THIS server's pinned fingerprint and its proof packs. Needs no secrets, changes no state.
Public-data checks on a payee (OFAC snapshot, card Luhn/length, IFSC shape). Evidence only; not a compliance clearance.
Import MOCK wallet spending so the forecast can switch from cold start to the student's own pattern.

Save the student's interface language in the Passport (student.language). Only the whitelisted UI codes are accepted
(`en`, `zh`; a region tag such as zh-CN is normalised); anything else is a 400 and changes nothing.

get.description: PUBLIC (what the QR opens): re-verifies the shared presentation now. The code only locates it.

post.description: Student only. Returns the holder copy; the salts in `disclosures` are what lets the student reveal payments later.
Parent only: accepting the earned threshold is the parent's decision; the student cannot raise it.
Student only. Stores a presentation that verifies against this server, under a short code for a QR.
Student only. Converts a Trust Pass this server issued into a W3C VC (did:key issuer, Ed25519 proof).
PUBLIC: verifies a pasted W3C VC export against THIS server's pinned key.
PUBLIC: verifies a pasted Trust Pass presentation against THIS server's pinned key and simulated clock.

Student only: one zero-knowledge threshold claim ('at least 94% on time', 'at least 5 payments') for a credential the
student holds. Refused (400) if the record does not meet it. The counts never leave the student's own request.

get.description:
PUBLIC. The fingerprint (sha256 over the canonical public keys) that verifiers must pin, and the approver device
keys (public keys only) the server vouches for.
